original.context: The first tame c=2 gate was reported passing. Its parameters are n=18,j=6,a=b=3 and color multiplicity m=binom(6,3)=20.

witness.explanation: The compressed contraction used |d|^2 instead of raw mass m|d|^2, making the reported T_a twenty times too small.
witness.evidence: The reported normalized value is160582822829/1705200. Multiplication by20 gives raw T_a=160582822829/85260. Its cap is51396202/35. Their exact ratio is36224413/28242984>1, with positive numerator excess7981429. Thus this gate fails. The second gate n=19 similarly has raw T_a=204466088827/71920 and cap137582445/64, ratio10611004/8023575>1. This refutes the physical T_a gate claim; it does not refute the original set-equality lower-bound theorem.
